verdict.rationale: Anytype's docs say you can invite collaborators into a shared Channel/space via keys, with peer-to-peer or self-hosted sync, so the sharing half of the story is documented first-party. Nothing in the pack describes simultaneous co-editing or how concurrent edits are merged without conflicts. One older community report said sharing was promoted but not yet available, which predates the current collaboration docs and lowers confidence rather than creating a dispute. Missing for 10: documented real-time or concurrent co-editing of the same note, conflict-resolution or merge behavior, recent independent hands-on corroboration of shared-space editing.
